speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of burning pain in his neck and arms, accompanying paresthesias in his hands. Over the past 3 months, he has experienced increasing weakness in both hands. He has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and hypertension. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cervical Spondylotic Myelopathy. The patient's one-year history of neck/arm pain, paresthesias, and progressive bilateral hand weakness, combined with age and diabetes, strongly suggests cervical spine stenosis. Please confirm if you have experienced any gait instability or clumsiness with your hands.
